message.content:
Heinrich Barth (1851) estimated Kano’s population at **30,000**, rising by perhaps 10,000 on market days.

Charles Henry Robinson (1894) estimated it at **50,000**. His method was to estimate the number of houses in the city and multiply by an assumed average of **five inhabitants per house**.
